name: Devil's Committee — AI Investment Debate Coach
description: An adversarial multi-agent debate committee for retail financial literacy. Bull/Bear/Macro/Risk agents argue a ticker using verified QuantSkills; an Audit agent independently checks each claim for overfitting, selection/survivorship bias and bad data; a Chair agent surfaces consensus, open disagreements and risk boundaries. It does NOT give buy/sell advice — it teaches you to judge. Research/education only, not investment advice.

skills.name: debate_case
skills.description: Run a full adversarial debate on a given ticker/portfolio question. Returns bull/bear/macro/risk arguments (each with evidence + cited QuantSkills), the audit verdict per claim, and a chair synthesis (consensus / open disagreements / risk boundaries). Never returns a buy/sell recommendation.
examples: 帮我理解一下 600519 现在多空双方各自的理由和风险
Explain both the bull and bear case for AAPL and audit which arguments are weak

skills.name: audit_claims
skills.description: Given a set of factor-based investment claims, independently check each for overfitting, selection/survivorship bias and bad data using QuantSkills audit workflows. Returns pass / suspected_overfit / selection_bias / bad_data / thin_data with reasoning. Never writes missing evidence up as pass.
examples: 审计这几条看多论据，哪些是挑出来的因子
